title: A Bell RINGS Before Every Mistake 🔔
description:
In this town, everyone wears a small brass bell on their collar, and it rings just before you make a mistake. Mine has never rung. Not once.

My big brother runs the car wash on the edge of town by himself now, and lately his bell won't stop ringing. So I went back to help him. Then the tunnel started running with nobody in it.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment BELL if yours would have rung this week.
